biography.value:
Description

A special order of knights under the Imperial Archadian Ministry of Law. With the spread of Archadian influence came a rise in crime and regional conflicts. To reduce the amount of time required by the judicial process, a military court was established, this being the origin of the Order of Judges.

Defense

AC 23, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (+9 armor, +2 Dex, +2 shield)

hp 66 [90] (5d12+30)

Fort +9, Ref +4, Will +5

Defensive Abilities DR 3/- while in armor

Offense

Speed 20 ft.

Melee Mwk Knight Sword +11 (1d10+5/19-20 x2)

Special Abilities Determination (1/day), Judgement (2/day), Judge's Might (7/day, 5 rounds)

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 16, Con 20, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 16

Base Atk +5; CMB +10; CMD 23

Feats Antagonize, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Endurance, Improved Initiative, Power Attack

Skills Diplomacy +11, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (Nobility) +7, Perception +9, Sense Motive +9

Languages Common

SQ Active Defense (+1), Always Wary (+3), Armored Defense, Armor Training (+1), Authority, Badge of Office, Heavy Weaponry, Knight Talents (Irrepressible Justice, Strength in Arms), Stern Gaze (+2), Threat Control

Gear Masterwork Knight Sword, Masterwork Full Plate, Masterwork Heavy Steel Shield

GM note: One additional language is unnamed. This LN judge chooses sacred bonuses. The source specifies seven daily uses of Might. The sword's masterwork +1 is included, not an additional attack bonus.

effect: When checking Sense Motive to see through Bluff concealing an attack, act in surprise regardless of the result and add Charisma to initiative.

effect: DR 3/- is included while wearing heavy armor. Remove it when not wearing armor.

description.value: Special quality listed in the source statblock: Armor Training (+1).

effect: Armor training improves armor check penalty and maximum Dexterity by one. Masterwork armor and shield each improve their own check penalty by one.

description.value: Special quality listed in the source statblock: Authority.

effect: On legal matters: +4 Diplomacy and Intimidate; may take 10 on checks concerning laws.

description.value: Special quality listed in the source statblock: Badge of Office.

effect: The equipped badge grants Endurance; Irrepressible Justice and Strength in Arms are included in printed Constitution and Strength. Heavy Weaponry affects wielding, not weapon damage dice.

effect: Treat yourself as one size larger for wielding weapons; this does not enlarge the weapon.
